insert into [rpy].[Dashboard_Data_Security]
(CREATION_DATE,EMAIL_ADDRESS,IS_DATA_ACCESS_ACTIVE,JOB_ROLE_NAME,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,SECURITY_CONTEXT,SECURITY_CONTEXT_VALUE,USERNAME,USER_ROLE_DATA_ASSIGNMENT_ID,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select a.CREATION_DATE,a.EMAIL_ADDRESS,a.IS_DATA_ACCESS_ACTIVE,a.JOB_ROLE_NAME,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.SECURITY_CONTEXT,a.SECURITY_CONTEXT_VALUE,a.USERNAME,a.USER_ROLE_DATA_ASSIGNMENT_ID,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time from [rpy].[Dashboard_Data_Security_stage] a,
(select USER_ROLE_DATA_ASSIGNMENT_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Dashboard_Data_Security_stage]
group by USER_ROLE_DATA_ASSIGNMENT_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.USER_ROLE_DATA_ASSIGNMENT_ID = b.USER_ROLE_DATA_ASSIGNMENT_ID
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE

scripts.text:
--Update the dim_ent_document_mileston_sequence table with latest conversion values for data_lake_standard_milestone_name

  UPDATE t1
  SET t1.[data_lake_standard_milestone_name] = t2.[data_lake_standard_milestone_name]
  FROM [dbo].[dim_ent_document_milestone_sequence] AS t1
  INNER JOIN [gpd].[NCSA_datalake_milestone_seq] AS t2
  ON t1.[milestone_gate_name] = t2.[milestone_gate_name]
  WHERE t1.active = 1;
